items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: No. Abe wasn't in the band. No, Hadnott. Abe was with the Blue Devils.

ctx.x: No. Abe wasn't in the band. No, Hadnott. Abe was with the Blue Devils. I think Abe got with George Lee or some other fellow after we came back. The Blue Devils broke up, and we all got back...
He's the bass player on that record I played you -- the J.P. Johnson.
